about_the_game:
This purchase includes the complete Original Soundtrack (OST) and the OST exclusive Original Vocal Soundtrack (OVST) Hyperdream Edition for a total of 18 tracks!

Disc 1:

Pussy Master: The Wet Pussy Pit Original Soundtrack, composed by Kink Master Studios.
This soundtrack contains 9 tracks, provided in both mp3 and wav format.

Disc 2 (OST exclusive):
